story.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2

carousel.cover_subheadline: 1,000 AI agents did 11 days of math in 30 hours. And it costs 20% less than OpenAI's top model.

slides.label: WHAT HAPPENED
slides.headline: Anthropic Launched Claude Fable 5.2 on November 9
slides.insight: Its most powerful public AI. A twin, Mythos 5.2, is locked to vetted security and science teams.

slides.label: THE MATH
slides.headline: 1,000 AI Agents Checked a Famous Proof in 30 Hours
slides.insight: Fortune says it was Fermat's Last Theorem. An earlier Claude needed 11 days.

slides.label: THE GADGETS
slides.headline: From One Paragraph, It Built 3 Working Gadgets
slides.insight: Circuit boards, 3D-printed cases and the software, according to Anthropic.

slides.label: THE NUMBER
slides.headline: Its Robot Control Score More Than Doubled
slides.insight: 64.9% vs 27.6% for Fable 5.1, on Anthropic's own RoboDojo test.

slides.label: THE SPEED
slides.headline: A 3.3-Hour Science Job Now Takes Under 4 Minutes
slides.insight: Physics code it rewrote ran about 36x faster on the same chip.

slides.label: THE PRICE
slides.headline: It Costs 20% Less Than OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra
slides.insight: $8 per million input tokens vs $10. Fast mode runs up to 2.5x quicker.

slides.label: THE CATCH
slides.headline: It Refuses Hacking and Risky Biology Requests
slides.insight: Flagged questions get handed to weaker models. The full-power twin is for approved experts only.

slides.label: WATCH OUT FOR
slides.headline: These Results Come From Anthropic Itself
slides.insight: Independent tests are still coming. Anthropic says AI now writes over 90% of its own code.

carousel.caption:
Claude Fable 5.2 is insane.

Claude Fable 5.2 launched on Nov 9. A team of 1,000 AI agents checked a famous math proof that took an earlier Claude 11 days.

It also built 3 working gadgets from a one-paragraph prompt, and it costs 20% less than OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.

The catch: these results come from Anthropic itself. Swipe for the full breakdown.
